get.summary: E25 Entry form: measurements with previous values and any saved assessment
get.description: `previous` is the latest value dated before `date` (BR-REC-81). Durations are seconds.

post.summary: E26 Save an assessment (creates, or edits the one for member + type + date)
post.description: Upsert: always 200; `created` says whether a new assessment was made. `value: null` removes a saved value; at most 60 values.

get.summary: E27 A member's assessments, newest first
get.description: Sorted by date then id; only `sortDir` is selectable (default `desc`).

get.summary: E28 One assessment with its values

patch.summary: E29 Move an assessment's date or mark it estimated
patch.description: Unknown fields rejected; at least one field. Moving the date moves its values.

delete.summary: E30 Delete an assessment with its values
delete.description: The one hard delete besides sign-ins and idempotency keys (BR-REC-165).

post.summary: E01 Sign in with the shared login
post.description:
Sets the httpOnly cookies `access_token` (JWT, 15 min) and `refresh_token`.
429 LOGIN_LOCKED: one lock for the whole login; `details.retryAfterSeconds` and a `Retry-After` header.

post.summary: E02 Refresh the sign-in (rotates the refresh cookie)
post.description: Reads the `refresh_token` cookie; no body. Works while the login is locked (BR-REC-171).
Clears the cookies. Public: it must work with an expired access token.

post.summary: E04 Sign out every device (this one too)
E06 Change the password (other devices are signed out)
post.description:
A wrong current password is 400, never 401: a 401 makes the app try a refresh and sign out.
A wrong current password counts toward the lock; while locked: 429 LOGIN_LOCKED as E01.

get.summary: E31 Who is overdue or due soon (Home and Due list)
get.description: One row per member per assessment. Order: Assess soon first, then most days overdue, then soonest due, then name (BR-REC-97). Archived and expired members are excluded (BR-REC-17).

get.summary: E32 One member's due status per assessment
get.description: A plain array, not paginated: one entry per turned-on assessment (bounded by the catalog).

put.summary: E33 Assess soon (flag) or Remind me later (snooze)
put.description: Body `{ action: 'flag' }` or `{ action: 'snooze', until: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }`. `until` is after today and at most 90 days ahead. The two replace each other.

delete.summary: E34 Clear Assess soon or Remind me later

get.description: 503 is returned when the database is unreachable (db: 'down').

`q` (2+ characters) matches name, phone or email; `phone` matches the last 10 digits.
Without `status`, archived members are left out; `status=any` includes them.

post.summary: E17 Add a member with the first membership period
post.description: Requires header `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` (BR-REC-156): a repeat with the same key within 48 h returns the first answer; the same key with a different body is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate that arrives while the first is still running waits up to 10 s, then gets 429 RATE_LIMITED. Only a successful (2xx) answer is stored: a failed request frees its key.

get.summary: E18 One member with membership and periods

patch.summary: E19 Edit a member (archived members too)
patch.description: Unknown fields rejected; at least one field.

post.description:
Requires header `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` (BR-REC-156): a repeat with the same key within 48 h returns the first answer; the same key with a different body is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; a duplicate that arrives while the first is still running waits up to 10 s, then gets 429 RATE_LIMITED. Only a successful (2xx) answer is stored: a failed request frees its key.
`memberRestored` is true when the period covers today and the member was archived (BR-REC-58).

patch.description: Unknown fields rejected; at least one field. Periods are never deleted.

get.summary: E24 Memberships ending soon or recently ended
get.description: `status=expiring`: soonest end first. `status=expired`: ended in the last 30 days, most recent first. Archived members are never listed (BR-REC-53).

get.summary: E36 Gym-wide progress for one measurement
get.description: 404 when `metricId` does not exist. Only members with 2+ readings count; `notCounted` says how many were left out.

get.summary: E37 Leaderboard for one measurement and sex
get.description: Ranked by latest value, best first by direction; equal values share a rank. 400 NO_DIRECTION for a measurement with no better direction.

get.summary: E39 CSV export (members, memberships or measurements)
get.description: Not JSON: the 200 body is CSV text (`text/csv; charset=utf-8`, UTF-8 with BOM, streamed), a documented exception to the envelope. `file` is one of members.csv, memberships.csv, measurements.csv; anything else is 404 NOT_FOUND.
Sends an `ETag`; a matching `If-None-Match` gets 304 with no body (BR-REC-160).

patch.description: Any of the settings; unknown fields rejected; at least one field.

get.description:
Ordered by setup order (`sortOrder`). Inactive ones only with includeInactive=true.
Sends an `ETag`; a matching `If-None-Match` gets 304 with no body (BR-REC-160).
